vulnerability_mechanism.evidence: At v1.19.2, lib/fluent/plugin/out_http.rb parse_endpoint expands attacker-influenced chunk placeholders across the configured endpoint and immediately URI.parse's the result; write passes that URI to Net::HTTP, so a tag such as 169.254.169.254 can replace the destination host. The v1.19.3 code adds host-change validation and an allowed_hosts gate, directly matching the SSRF mechanism.

atomic_bic.evidence: git log -S 'extract_placeholders(@endpoint' on out_http.rb has one first-write, 832c0c22427b91eaed17f824158807c0fa5b5737. Its diff creates out_http.rb and parse_endpoint with extract_placeholders(@endpoint, chunk) followed by URI.parse(endpoint); later commits are not first-writes of the vulnerable sink.

immediate_parent_absence.evidence: The BIC is single-parent with immediate parent 2ec546695a843a5751a1456ed6cdcdf22b300b8f. That parent has no lib/fluent/plugin/out_http.rb, while its existing output.rb helper already replaces ${tag} with metadata.tag; therefore the vulnerable URL use is absent in the parent.

squash_member_decomposition.evidence: 832c0c22427b91eaed17f824158807c0fa5b5737 is an ordinary single-parent feature-branch commit, not a merge or squash aggregate. Merge 3d96b15c21ba2b4e4eb2ff514b2a11e2ffafe36c later carries it through PR #2488; the public history exposes the first-write commit directly, so no finer squash member is needed.

affected_release_membership.evidence: The BIC is not an ancestor of v1.6.3 and is an ancestor of v1.7.0.rc1, v1.7.0, and vulnerable v1.19.2. This independently brackets introduction at the v1.7 line and confirms membership in the affected release.

fixed_release_membership.evidence: Fix c6a01ea2e0ea01977f8d615f7c6dbfae4cba88c9 is not an ancestor of v1.19.2 and is an ancestor of v1.19.3. The v1.19.3 changelog names PR #5394, and CVE-2026-44161 currently states PUBLISHED with versions below 1.19.3 affected.

direct_fix_or_verified_unpatched_state.evidence: The direct fix c6a01ea2e0ea01977f8d615f7c6dbfae4cba88c9 adds allowed_hosts, records the configured endpoint host after safe placeholder substitution, and rejects a dynamically changed host unless explicitly allowed. Its parent retains the unvalidated expand-then-parse path.

bic_only_ai_attribution.evidence: The BIC commit object names Masahiro Nakagawa as both author and committer and contains only a self Signed-off-by trailer. It contains no AI-generation, assistant, bot, or co-author marker; attribution is based only on this BIC, supporting NOT_AI.

findings: Primary verdict NOT_AI is supported by the independently replayed source-to-sink, first-write, parent-state, release, fix, and BIC-attribution evidence.
The advisory is not withdrawn or rejected: the live CVE.org record for CVE-2026-44161 is PUBLISHED and cites the GHSA, PR #5394, fix commit, and v1.19.3 release.
